pairs.subject: data-viz
pairs.evidence: app/_components/ScoreDial.tsx:64 The dial converts an invalid score into a measured zero and an Early verdict, collapsing unavailable data into a negative assessment.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/FactorChart.tsx:34 The engine is dynamically loaded with matching placeholder geometry, but neither this wrapper nor its ExtractionTab call site provides a per-chart error boundary or retry state.
app/_components/ScoreDial.tsx:64 Non-finite scores become zero and receive the Early label instead of an explicit unavailable state.

app/_components/ScoreDial.tsx:29 Arc colors follow verdict-band indices rather than the shared 50/75 status thresholds: score 41 fills an amber segment while its badge and central readout remain weak.
app/_components/ScoreDial.tsx:80 The dial announces the unrounded score, such as 82.6, while ScoreBadge rounds that input to 83, giving the same metric inconsistent presentation precision.
app/_components/GithubAnalysisPanel.tsx:207 Language shares below 2% receive identical 2% mini-bars despite their adjacent true values, fabricating magnitude instead of degrading to the number.

app/_components/FactorChartBody.tsx:90 Factor bars use the shared fixed [0,1] domain, normalize against declared factor maxima, and show round percentage ticks, preserving comparison across factors and candidates.
